name: Image occlusion
description: Cover parts of an image and name each one. Every box, or group of boxes, is its own card. Unlabeled boxes are shown and self-graded.

fields.name: boxes
fields.label: Boxes
fields.description: [{ id, x, y, w, h, label, group }], coordinates from 0 to 1 of the image. A label takes alternatives: "Aorta|aortic arch". Boxes that share a group are asked together.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: hide-all: every box is covered and one is asked. hide-one: only the asked box is covered.

instructions: The learner names the highlighted part of the image. Accept the box's label or any of its |-separated alternatives; ignore case, accents and small typos. Never accept the name of a different box.
